social.text: New BeRoTracker version, and the big new thing: you can now program your own sounds right inside the tracker. The language is called Aulan, and it came from my other older tracker project called CreamTracker. It is small and statically typed, and BeRoTracker compiles it to native x86-64/AArch64 code when a song loads. With it you can write a sample that is computed instead of recorded, an instrument with a voice of its own on every channel, effects and instruments for the modular editor, and global code that hears every channel before the master. The programs are saved with the song, so it sounds the same everywhere. Shift+F12 opens the code editor, Ctrl+Enter applies a change while the song keeps playing, and the complete language reference is in the built-in help. There is more: you can now draw samples by hand in the sample editor (Alt+D), start from an empty sample of any length (Alt+B), and one instrument can play its sample, an FM voice and an Aulan voice together. BeRoTracker is free, runs on Linux, Windows and macOS, and needs no installation: download the ZIP, extract it, run it. https://www. berotracker.com # daw # musicproduction # programming # coding # tracker

social.text: 🎹 The M-VAVE FM-1 might be the most hacked piece of synth hardware out right now. It's a cheap little FM synth with a full color screen, USB MIDI and audio, battery power, and an output jack, for under $100. M-VAVE never shipped an SDK, so people reverse engineered the thing and built their own, and the firmware scene has exploded: 45 firmwares two weeks ago, 154 today. Some of what you can install: BauGirl's firmware, which fixes the original engine's bugs, adds an entirely new synthesis engine and a UI nicer than most commercial synths. Groove OS, which turns it into a full groovebox. Feluca, the open source firmware that added Mutable Instruments style physical modeling and opened the floodgates. Grim for haunted dungeon synth. AM1, a generative ambient machine inspired by Eno's Music for Airports. Coral Flower, loosely inspired by the Telepathic Instruments Orchid. Obervave for late 70s Oberheim sounds. And dozens more in every direction. MVAVE took it well and released their own open source SDK and a community-modifiable firmware. Behringer and Akai have both announced competing open source hardware projects, and an FM2 is teased. social.text: Isolation shot vs two shot 🎬 Isolation shot (a clean single): one character alone in the frame. It focuses us on their emotion and can make them feel alone. Two shot: both characters in frame. It shows distance, closeness and power between them, and lets us watch one react while the other acts. Most dialogue scenes mix both. Go to singles too early, and it turns into ping-pong. # Filmmaking # Cinematography # TwoShot # FilmTechnique # Coverage

social.text: Comedic framing 🎬 Comedy isn’t just in the script. It’s in where you put the camera. Go wide so physical gags play out in full. Use a two-shot to show contrast between characters. Cut to the reaction, because the reaction is often the punchline. Hold the reveal outside the frame, then show it.
